concept.hr: Neprilagođen teret reflektira snagu, a na vodu nastaje stojni val
concept.en: A mismatched load reflects power and a standing wave forms on the line

summary.hr: Mijenjaj otpor tereta i gledaj ovojnicu stojnog vala, upadni i povratni val i SWR-metre na oba kraja voda. Gubitak kabela uljepša očitanje.
summary.en: Change the load resistance and watch the standing-wave envelope, the forward and reflected waves and SWR meters at both ends. Cable loss flatters the reading.

what.hr: Tekst odjeljaka o SWR-u i SWR-metru (swr, swr_2, swr_3, swr_meter_1, swr_meter_2; 50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod): pravila, primjeri i brojke
what.en: The text of the SWR and SWR meter sections (swr, swr_2, swr_3, swr_meter_1, swr_meter_2; 50ohm.de, Croatian translation): rules, examples and numbers

changes.hr: Pravila i primjeri pretočeni u interaktivni simulator; tekst prerađen i preveden na engleski
changes.en: Rules and examples turned into an interactive simulator; text reworked and translated into English
